title: eAssistant: Cognitive Assistance for Identification and Auto-Triage of Actionable Conversations
abstract: Presents fine-grained identification of individual actions and associated metadata in productivity communication including email, chat, messaging, and social collaboration tools, evaluated on real-world datasets. Its request and promise representations associate participants with an action and allow an optional due date or time, making the work relevant to owner and deadline binding rather than merely actionable-message classification.
venue: Proceedings of the 26th International Conference on World Wide Web Companion
